{
  "phoneNote": "The bakery photography and warm typography work well, but repeated opening-hours and contact blocks make the phone page unnecessarily long.",
  "desktopNote": "The hero feels inviting and bakery-specific, but uneven product cards and oversized empty areas weaken the rhythm further down the page.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Consolidate opening hours into one contact/location section instead of showing them three times; keep the introductory contact strip compact.",
    "Separate photographed products from the text-only price list so missing images do not create tall blank cards; place each price directly beneath its product name.",
    "Tighten the desktop story section around its content and reduce the unloaded map panel’s height so neither leaves a large empty area."
  ]
}
